canonical_outcome_labels.evidence_level: RUN-LEVEL HISTORICAL METADATA, confirmed by the project owner
canonical_outcome_labels.caveat: Row-level judge provenance exists only for rows annotated on or after 2026-08-04, when judge_model was added to the schema. It has NOT been back-filled: doing so would fabricate row-level provenance for legacy labels.

judge_prompt_version_drift_diagnosis: Two distinct judge_prompt_version hashes appear among rows that carry one. This is IMPLEMENTATION DRIFT, not codebook drift: the version is a hash over all large triple-quoted blocks in annotation_pipeline.py, so unrelated edits (added helper docstrings) changed it while the Pass 1-3 codebooks were untouched. Treat differing hashes here as manifest drift. It is NOT a reason to re-run paid annotation.

additional_judges.storage: long form under <run_dir>/panel/<judge>/, separate from the canonical outcome
additional_judges.note: Every judge is reported separately in e38 with a judge-sensitivity range. No consensus label is treated as ground truth.

panel_judge_id_drift: Judge identifiers in panel artifacts are filesystem-safe slugs (slashes -> '__'), so they differ textually from the model IDs in the panel config. The mapping is mechanical and reversible. Config/manifest drift only.
